meta.name: shadcn
meta.description: Manages shadcn components and projects — adding, searching, fixing, debugging, styling, and composing UI, including chat interfaces. Provides project context, component docs, and usage examples. Applies when working with shadcn/ui, component registries, presets, --preset codes, or any project with a components.json file. Also triggers for "shadcn init", "create an app with --preset", or "switch to --preset".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理 shadcn 组件和项目，添加、搜索、修复、调试和组合 UI
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果使用 shadcn/ui 构建 React 界面，需要管理组件和项目配置
copy.tagline_en: Manage shadcn components and projects: add, search, fix, debug, and compose UI
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build React UIs with shadcn/ui and need to manage components and project config

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会管理 shadcn 组件和项目：添加、搜索、修复、调试、样式化、组合 UI（含聊天界面）。它先查项目配置与已装组件，再按官方规则和文档操作。
howto.when: 当你提到 shadcn/ui、组件注册表或 preset 等关键词，或要求执行 init、--preset 等操作时触发；项目带 components.json 也会激活。

say.text: 用 shadcn 帮我加一个对话框组件。
say.note: 会运行 CLI 添加组件并检查代码。

say.text: 看看项目里装了哪些 shadcn 组件？给我列出来。
say.note: 会读取项目上下文并列出已安装组件。

say.text: 这个配置页的布局不合规，按 shadcn 规则帮我改。
say.note: 会按规则修正组件组合和样式。

howto.what_en: Claude manages shadcn components/projects: add, search, fix, debug, style, compose UI (incl. chat). It reads project config & installed components first, then follows official rules/docs.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention shadcn/ui, component registries, or preset keywords, or ask for init/--preset operations; also activates for projects with a components.json file.

say_en.text: Add a dialog component using shadcn.
say_en.note: Runs the CLI to add and verify the component.

say_en.text: What shadcn components are installed in this project? List them.
say_en.note: Reads project context and lists installed components.

say_en.text: This settings page layout doesn't follow shadcn rules—fix it.
say_en.note: Fixes composition and styling per the rules.
